preparation_steps:
- step_number: 1
  action: AUTOCLAVE
  description: 1. After detergent cleaning, all glassware is rinsed thoroughly with
    glass-distilled water and then autoclaved.
- step_number: 2
  action: MIX
  description: 2. To 900ml of glass-distilled water are added 100ml of 10X concentrate
    of CMRL 1066 without glutamine (Gibco Laboratories, GrandIsland, NY, No.330-1540).
- step_number: 3
  action: DISSOLVE
  description: Add the source-listed ingredients to the diluted CMRL 1066. The provider
    requests an addition order, but its item array is not accepted as that order;
    exact addition order remains unresolved here.
- step_number: 4
  action: ADJUST_PH
  description: 4. Adjust pH of medium at 20-25°C to 7.6 with 1 N NaOH.
- step_number: 5
  action: MIX
  description: 5. Add 200ml of 7 percent gelatin (Difco) which had been dissolved
    in boilinig water.
- step_number: 6
  action: FILTER
  description: 6. Sterilize by filtration with air pressure (0.2 μm nitrocellulose,
    Millipore Corp., Bedford, MA). Store medium at 4°C.
- step_number: 7
  action: MIX
  description: 7. Before use, add unheated rabbit serum(\"trace hemolyzed\"; Pel-Freez
    Biologicals, Inc., Rogers, AR) to a final concentration of 6 percent.
- step_number: 8
  action: ALIQUOT
  description: 8. Dispense to glass or polystyrene tubes or bottles. Fill containers
    to 50 to 90 percent capacity and captightly.*
